note: Rule content and advisory presentation approved by the product owner on 1 October 2026; this is not governmental app certification. Ordinary passenger-car first-offence warning estimates; no Swiss licence points. Legal bands use excess after the actual enforcement measurement deduction; raw GPS excess is illustrative and is not an assessed offence or a guaranteed fine. Motorway classification uses the matched highway, never the numeric posted limit. Unknown, trunk or motorway-link-only category suppresses exact figures: divided Autostrassen may follow motorway withdrawal thresholds, which a trunk tag alone does not establish. Raser thresholds depend on the posted limit. The normal 24-month minimum can be reduced to at least 12 months only in qualifying statutory cases; repeat/probationary offences and case-specific criminal penalties require separate assessment. See docs/SWISS_PENALTY_CORRECTION_REVIEW_2026-10-01.md.

en.detail_template: Posted-limit-dependent Raser threshold reached. Normally at least 24 months licence withdrawal; qualifying statutory exceptions may reduce the minimum to 12 months. Criminal penalties and possible vehicle measures are assessed individually. GPS excess does not establish an offence.

Straf- und mögliche Fahrzeugmaßnahmen werden individuell beurteilt. GPS-Überschreitung stellt keinen amtlichen Verstoß fest.
